mechanism_narrative: A sustained decline in the federal funds rate over the past three months indicates an accommodative monetary policy stance that lowers discount rates and boosts equity valuations, producing positive S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: 20-day forward returns are negative in more than 55% of instances where FEDFUNDS declines over the past three months, or Rank IC remains below 0.03 over any 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: When the federal funds rate rises above 1.5% in a single month, it signals imminent monetary tightening that increases discount rates and reduces equity valuations, causing negative S&P 500 returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: 5-day forward returns are positive in more than 55% of instances where FEDFUNDS exceeds 1.5%, or Rank IC remains below 0.03 over any 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: A simultaneous decline in unemployment rate and increase in retail sales (RSAFS) indicates a strengthening labor market driving consumer spending, which signals robust corporate earnings growth and positive S&P 500 returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: 60-day forward returns are negative in more than 55% of instances where UNRATE declines and RSAFS increases, or Rank IC remains below 0.03 over any 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: In high GDP growth regimes (GDPC1 > 2.5% annualized), a monthly rise in housing starts exceeding 0.5% signals strong consumer demand and construction activity, driving positive S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: 20-day forward returns are negative in more than 55% of instances where GDPC1 > 2.5% annualized and HOUST rises > 0.5%, or Rank IC remains below 0.03 over any 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: A sustained upward trend in non-farm payrolls (PAYEMS) over the past three months indicates a strengthening labor market that increases consumer spending and corporate profits, leading to positive S&P 500 returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: 5-day forward returns are negative in more than 55% of instances where PAYEMS increases over the past three months, or Rank IC remains below 0.03 over any 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: When the unemployment rate falls below 4.0% in a single month, it signals a tight labor market that may trigger wage inflation and central bank tightening, causing negative S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: 20-day forward returns are positive in more than 55% of instances where UNRATE falls below 4.0%, or Rank IC remains below 0.03 over any 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: A simultaneous decline in industrial production (INDPRO) and rise in inflation (CPIAUCSL) indicates a supply shock that increases input costs and reduces corporate margins, leading to negative S&P 500 returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: 60-day forward returns are positive in more than 55% of instances where INDPRO declines and CPIAUCSL rises, or Rank IC remains below 0.03 over any 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: In high industrial production regimes (INDPRO > 105), a further monthly increase in manufacturing output signals strong economic momentum and positive earnings outlook, driving positive S&P 500 returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: 60-day forward returns are negative in more than 55% of instances where INDPRO > 105 and INDPRO rises > 0.5%, or Rank IC remains below 0.03 over any 3-year rolling window.
